inner.title: ask them directly
inner.body: add a how did you hear about us field at signup. in 8,528 b2b answers, 18% said word of mouth, a channel no tracker has.
inner.label: 18% invisible

inner.title: last touch lies
inner.body: last touch credits the final click before a lead converts. when email was that click, only 21% of buyers said email brought them.
inner.label: 21% match

inner.title: tag every link
inner.body: ga4 only files a visit under email when the source or medium says email. anything it can't match lands in unassigned.
inner.label: unassigned

inner.title: tag the payment
inner.body: stripe checkout takes metadata on every session, so save the first source there. otherwise your revenue never meets your traffic.
inner.label: follow the money

inner.title: your podcast problem
inner.body: 46% of companies in one study had a podcast. only 12 of 8,528 buyers named a podcast as how they found them.

closer.HEADLINE:
traffic is a guess.
revenue is the answer
closer.TONIGHT: add a how did you hear field
closer.NEXT_WEEK: save first source on each payment
